title: Fairy Tail
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Natsu Dragneel, a fire-wielding Dragon Slayer in the wizard guild Fairy Tail, searches for his missing dragon father. With celestial wizard Lucy, the cat Happy and other guildmates, he takes jobs and battles dark guilds, demons, an immortal dark wizard and an invading empire.
life_message: A good life means fierce loyalty to the guild that is your family.
